site.title: Missing Persons Registry – Tanzania
about.heading: About this registry
about.why: Across Tanzania, people are taken — sometimes by armed men in civilian clothes, sometimes never to be seen again. Families search for answers while official records stay silent. This registry is maintained by civil-society volunteers to document every case, so that no one is forgotten and so that the record cannot simply be erased.
about.survives_1: This website is a static site — it has no database of cases that can be quietly edited or switched off. Every verified case is stored as a permanent, open JSON record in a public repository that anyone can read, copy and archive.
about.survives_2: The site is served from independent mirrors, and any person or organization can re-host the entire registry from the public repository. The more mirrors, the stronger the record.
about.protection_1: Reports submitted through this site go only to a private review queue that is accessible solely to our small moderation team. Reports are reviewed before anything is published, and we never publish the identity of a submitter.
about.protection_2: You may submit completely anonymously — no name, email or account is required. If you are at risk, do not use the form: send a tip on Signal instead, which requires nothing that identifies you.
about.verification: Every case requires at least two independent sources, or direct confirmation from the family, before it is marked as verified. Unverified cases are labelled as such. Corrections and removal requests from families are honoured.
about.mirror: The full source code and all case records are published in our public repository. You can fork it and serve the static build from any static host — each mirror makes the record harder to erase.
about.safety: If you are in danger, contact a trusted lawyer or a human-rights organisation such as the Legal and Human Rights Centre (LHRC) in Dar es Salaam. When documenting a case, put the family's safety first: get consent, and never share details that could identify a family at risk.

submit.heading: Report a Disappearance
submit.intro: Your report goes to our secure review queue. You may remain anonymous.
submit.signal_note: If you are at risk, do not use this form — contact the team on Signal instead.
submit.name_label: Full name of the missing person
submit.tip_banner: You are sharing sighting information about an existing case — the name is pre-filled below:
submit.tip_circumstances_label: What did you see? Where and when did you see this person?
submit.tip_placeholder: e.g. I saw him at Kariakoo market on Friday evening — describe exactly where, when, and what they were wearing…
submit.photo_label: Photo Image URL link (e.g. https://... or image link - optional)
submit.contact_label: Your contact (optional – Signal number or email)
submit.consent_label: I confirm I have the family's consent to share this information.
submit.success: Thank you. Your report has been received and will be reviewed before publication.
submit.error: Something went wrong. Please try the primary site or contact the team on Signal.
